text: 中国财政部发行91天期债券，规模600亿元，发行利率1.1330%，边际利率1.1827%，预期1.1100%，投标倍数2.50倍，边际倍数3.90倍； 中国财政部发行1年期债券，规模1200亿元，发行利率1.1600%，边际利率1.1900%，预期1.2000%，投标倍数3.37倍，边际倍数5.38倍； 中国财政部发行50年期债券，规模300亿元，发行利率2.2166%，预期2.2200%，投标倍数9.30倍，边际倍数2.51倍。
text_en: China's Ministry of Finance issued 91-day bonds, with a scale of 60 billion yuan, an issuance rate of 1.1330%, a marginal rate of 1.1827%, an expected rate of 1.1100%, a bid-to-cover ratio of 2.50 times, and a marginal ratio of 3.90 times; China's Ministry of Finance issued 1-year bonds, with a scale of 120 billion yuan, an issuance rate of 1.1600%, a marginal rate of 1.1900%, an expected rate of 1.2000%, a bid-to-cover ratio of 3.37 times, and a marginal ratio of 5.38 times; China's Ministry of Finance issued 50-year bonds, with a scale of 30 billion yuan, an issuance rate of 2.2166%, an expected rate of 2.2200%, a bid-to-cover ratio of 9.30 times, and a marginal ratio of 2.51 times.
